summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Tremorscale (set). Tremorscale is a duneripper boss of Volenfell, found in an oasis area of the dungeon guarding the door to The Guardian's Orbit. It is also the namesake of the Tremorscale set and the basis of a trophy, bust, and style; however, it does not drop any of them, as they are instead obtained from killing the Guardian Trinity.
